source: NIAAA, National Epidemiologic Survey on Alcohol and Related Conditions III (NESARC-III), 2012–2013
population: US adults 18 and older who drank in the past year
derivation: The published mean number of days on which past-year drinkers drank, 87.9 a year (up from 83.5 in 2001–2002). Scaled to a window by days × 87.9 / 365: about 6.7 days in 28, about 87.7 in 364. A mean, not a distribution, so the app states both numbers and never a percentile.
